intent_snapshot.goal: Deliver ADR 0043 Slice 2 per docs/specs/external-approval-seam.spec.md: add strictest-wins boolean external_approval (default false) to v2 layered config, admit external_approval in Kernel Enrollment confirmation recording confirmation_source on TaskRecordV4, expose imm-kernel approve <task-id> [--finding <id> --resolution <text> | --stop <reason>] [--actor <id>] --json and extend imm-kernel inspect [--task <id> [--run <run-id>]] --json for open user decisions and settled .imm/audit/ proof verification, and amend ADR 0043/0041, config docs, instruction guards, and Host bundles with zero takt coupling (BR-REQ-1..4, BR-DEC-1..5, BR-OUT-1..4, BR-SCN-1..2).

acceptance.assertion: Per docs/specs/external-approval-seam.spec.md AC1 (agreed seams: tests/layered-config.test.ts, tests/batch-agreement.test.ts, tests/kernel-enrollment-authority.test.ts), layered_config.ts resolves boolean external_approval in v2 user/project configs with default false and strictest-wins merge (false in either layer or invalid/broken config yields false and non-boolean emits config_invalid causing imm-kernel config --json to exit 1), migrateConfig preserves v2 external_approval, verifyEnrollmentConfirmation admits external_approval only when external_approval_enabled is true across routine/material/critical while rejecting disabled/tracker_approval/policy_auto, and enrollTask persists confirmation_source: external_approval on TaskRecordV4 while leaving user_session omitted (BR-DEC-1, BR-DEC-2, BR-OUT-4).

Per docs/specs/external-approval-seam.spec.md AC2 and BR-SCN-1..2 (agreed seams: tests/external-approval-cli.test.ts, tests/kernel-inspect.test.ts, tests/v4-runtime-launchers.test.ts), imm-kernel approve <task-id> [--finding <id> --resolution <text> | --stop <reason>] [--actor <id>] --json fails closed with exit 1 external_approval_disabled when external_approval is unset/false, rejects untracked intents (exit 1 intent_untracked), duplicate/stale/terminal transitions (exit 1), and malformed flag combinations (exit 2 invalid_command), and when external_approval is true executes headless Enrollment, resolve_user_decision (including verifier disputes under literal-user), and stop while keeping runKernelCommand synchronous; imm-kernel inspect [--task <id> [--run <run-id>]] --json exposes unresolved_user_decisions summaries when active and verified .imm/audit/<task-id>/<run-id>/ metadata when settled, rejecting missing (task_audit_missing) or tampered (task_audit_invalid) audit pairs with exit 1 and creating no state on idle workspaces (BR-REQ-3, BR-REQ-4, BR-DEC-3, BR-DEC-5, BR-OUT-2, BR-OUT-3).

Per docs/specs/external-approval-seam.spec.md AC3 (agreed seams: tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, tests/claude-host-package.test.ts, tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts, tests/dist-docs-sync-contract.test.ts), ADR 0043 Decision 4 and Slice 2, ADR 0041 Decision 2, and docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md document external_approval, imm-kernel approve, and imm-kernel inspect [--task] with zero takt/gate/v1, GateRequest, GateResponse, .takt/, or returning policy_auto clauses; BASELINE.md and executor.md forbid Managed/Agent sessions from invoking imm-kernel approve while keeping Claude PreToolUse Bash unrouted; runtime/kernel imports nothing from runtime/config or runtime/host-core; and Claude, Antigravity, and dist/ checks pass with zero drift (BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-4, BR-OUT-1).
